units.source_text: 看见黑131，名人依然把胸脯挺得笔直，伸长脖子，焦灼地敲打着桐木火盆的边。

en.t: When he saw Black 131, the Master still held his chest perfectly straight, craned his neck, and anxiously tapped the edge of the paulownia brazier.

units.source_text: 他一边敏锐地扫视了一下棋盘，一边默算着棋局。

en.t: He quickly swept a sharp glance over the board while silently calculating the position.
